item.title: Pull request #3101 created
item.description:
2917 Drop implementation-defined appendices

This PR proposes to simplify our life by dropping the list. It’s always possible to look for ·implementation-defined· features in the full text.

If we decide to keep it, though… It was not much effort to create this PR. Most of the time that I spent was to make sections visible in the rules that would have completely disappeared otherwise.

Closes #2917
